objective: Using only frozen M46, M54, and M58 ledgers, separate smooth matched-background-Boron Id-Vg error growth from low-current default-minus-Direct substrate electron-current bursts, without treating the observable difference as an independently measured continuity residual or changing any historical artifact.

closed_topics: M50-M55 default, CurrentWeighting, DirectCurrent, and DopingWell observable attribution

frozen_analysis_rules.observable_gap: substrate eCurrent default minus substrate eCurrent Direct at the same frozen state
frozen_analysis_rules.observable_fraction: observable_gap / Sentaurus default drain Id; signed value retained
frozen_analysis_rules.interpretation_guard: observable_gap is directly measured from M54; inferred p-well continuity residual is a box-method hypothesis, not an independent ledger column, until M60
frozen_analysis_rules.curve_metric: maximum absolute Vela-Sentaurus log10 current ratio before and after excluding points at or above the selected absolute observable fraction
frozen_analysis_rules.local_excess: 10**(point_dex - mean clean-neighbor dex within plus-or-minus 0.10 V) - 1
frozen_analysis_rules.slope: zero-intercept least-squares local_excess versus signed observable_fraction
frozen_analysis_rules.correlation: Pearson correlation reported descriptively; low- and high-drain scopes must be reported separately
frozen_analysis_rules.roughness: log10(Id) at an interior gate point minus the cubic through the two previous and two next lattice points; no claim at Vg=0.05 V where two previous points do not exist
frozen_analysis_rules.historical_artifact_policy: write new M59 ledgers only; do not add columns to or rewrite M46/M54/M58 files

classifications.port_observable_burst_association_plus_s: All eight matched pair/drain rows retain a positive 0.020-0.027 dex burst-free maximum-error growth over the frozen threshold range, low-drain local excess is strongly associated with the default-minus-Direct substrate observable fraction, and large default KCL sums stratify with the frozen floating-component devices; continuity-residual causality remains pending M60.
classifications.smooth_nwell_growth_without_port_burst_a: Burst-free growth is systematic but the low-drain observable association or KCL/topology stratification fails.
classifications.port_burst_without_systematic_smooth_gro: The low-drain observable association passes but burst-free matched growth is not systematic.
classifications.upstream_or_analysis_mismatch: An input hash, matrix size, exact state join, threshold sensitivity, or required field check fails.

next_gate.hypothesis: tightening Sentaurus nonlinear convergence controls reduces the default-minus-Direct substrate observable burst while preserving non-burst curve points
next_gate.claim_guard: M59 authorizes a frozen M60 convergence-control experiment but does not establish Sentaurus residual causality, a solver defect, or a production-reference change.

forbidden_work: historical M46, M54, or M58 artifact rewrite
calling default-minus-Direct an independently exported nodal residual
using the global mixed-drain slope as a universal drain partition coefficient
claiming the smooth component is already attributed to BGN, electrostatics, or mobility
HFS, SG, BGN, SRH, mobility, contact, interface, mesh, doping, or production-default change
required_artifacts: frozen contract and upstream hash manifest
KCL and frozen topology stratification ledger
machine-readable report, evidence manifest, regression test, and corrected human report
